reserveReview.rationale: The entire holder instrument is an operational protocol-position claim, not a measured 100% USDC cash reserve. At Ethereum block 26196064 (2026-10-15T06:16:59Z), the vault still has two subvaults. A bounded five-token balance census finds subvault 0 holds 15212506004451727577664921 raw earnUSDc shares, 48692137485 raw USDC and 130611051366 raw USDT; subvault 1 holds 40779186888805424391750779 raw earnUSDe shares and 49359624869 raw USDC. This is an immediate technical observation, not a complete look-through inventory or valued portfolio allocation. Mellow names earnUSDc on Ethereum/Base and earnUSDe on Ethereum/Plasma/Mantle; Lido's current registry additionally lists earnUSDe on Robinhood. These are underlying strategy deployments, not earnUSD holder-token representations. The official interface discloses liquidity provision and leverage risk without measured gearing. Neither these observations nor the aggregate API supplies complete holdings, debt, encumbrance and share-liability reconciliation; no current look-through weights are inferred.
